title: Observe fleet for a week after opum-workflow 0.4.0 restart
summary: Per opum-agent, after the fleet restarts onto opum-workflow 0.4.0: observe for a week that (1) OMARK-10/OPAG-62's fix holds -- no orchestrator idle message relayed as a worker needs-input alert in any repo, and (2) OMARK-18/OPAG-63's skill amendment holds -- no direct commit to dev in any fleet repository. These are OMARK-10's own acceptance criterion 2 and part of OPAG-63's acceptance criteria, both of which needed post-release observation and couldn't be checked at merge time. OMARK-10 is already archived (Done/completed), so this is filed separately rather than reopening it -- quest task edit refuses a completed task, same gap OMARK-19 recorded for OMARK-13.
